entry.title: Share a little of the cleanup
entry.summary: At a meal already underway, offer a cloth and let your baby join a small part of wiping. You can finish what still needs doing.
entry.cue: Your baby is interested in the cloth or in your wiping movement.
detail: The authors describe a cloth for hands and mouth and a little shared table wiping. Their eight-month-old example is imperfect, with the adult still doing cleanup.
This is participation in an ordinary moment, not a task your baby needs to finish.

references.locator: Cloth and eight-month table-wiping example with adult cleanup

ageContext.bookAge: The book gives an eight-month table-wiping example with imperfect results.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in a cloth or the adult’s wiping during an existing meal.

displayContext.footer: You don’t need a different home. Start with what you have.
displayContext.colophon: Original summaries inspired by The Montessori Baby and The Montessori Toddler. Open any idea for its book references. The illustration is an invitation to explore, rather than a room to reproduce. Follow your child’s pace.
